verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks that a programmatic consumer can receive. Users set up a webhook of a given event type (e.g. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED) with a documented payload, each delivery carries a webhook-id header for idempotency, and signing is available per account. Missing for 10: a full catalog of subscribable event types, explicit documentation of the registration mechanism (API vs UI) and retry/delivery semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Set up a webhook of type `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`
Every webhook we send carries a `webhook-id` header
Webhook signing is opt-in per account.
